content.title: Emailing a university?
content.subtitle: A clear email gets a faster reply.

steps.title: Clear subject line
steps.detail: Course name and question in one line. For example: MS Data Science, document query.

steps.title: Read the website first
steps.detail: If the FAQ already answers it, check there once before you ask.

steps.title: Keep it short
steps.detail: Your name, application ID and one clear question. No long story.

steps.title: Polite tone
steps.detail: Start with Dear Admissions Team and end with a thank you.

steps.title: Follow up on time
steps.detail: No reply? Wait a few working days, then send one short reminder.
steps.tip: Use a professional email ID, not one with a nickname.

caption:
Need to email a university but not sure how? Follow these 5 rules 👇

1. Clear subject line
2. Read the website first
3. Keep it short
4. Polite tone
5. Follow up on time

Save it 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.

👉 app.goeduabroad.com
